title: Nhan dataset card (nhan.json)
description: Written by the Nhan app (and the SDK) next to every export. Says what each label name in the export means. See sdk/SPEC.md section 3.

nhan_card_version.description: Layout version of this file. Readers must refuse versions they do not know.

created_at.description: UTC time of the export, ISO 8601.

label_style.description: single: no sub-categories. joined: values are part of the label name (mango_ripe). separate_fields: the label is the class; values are in COCO annotations[].attributes or VOC <attributes>.

shapes.description: Which label shapes the export holds. Polygons: COCO annotations[].segmentation, YOLO segmentation lines (a box is written as its 4 corners when the export has polygons), VOC only the box around each polygon.

separator.description: Text between the parts of a joined name, e.g. _ or .

lowercase.description: True when every name in the export was written in lower case.

root_category.description: What the main class is called, e.g. fruit. COCO supercategory in separate_fields style.

sub_categories.description: In order. The order is the order of the parts in a joined name.

labels.description: Every label name used in the export files, in export order. For YOLO the position is the class index.

attributes.description: Sub-category -> value carried by the name. A missing key means no value. Empty in separate_fields style.

written_by.description: Set by tools other than the app, e.g. nhan-sdk.
